scene_context.physical_setting: Fast casual restaurant interior (bar area) followed by a corporate office setting
scene_context.social_context: Workplace conflict resolution followed by a benevolent authority intervention
scene_context.temporal_context: Daytime; sequence spans a confrontation event and a subsequent debriefing meeting
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Initially high-tension/hostile, transitioning to emotional release/relief, ending in gratitude/joy

characters.physical_description: Adult male, brown hair, wearing black t-shirt with logo (Scene 1), later wearing suit jacket (Scene 2)

initial_state.body_language_summary: Aggressive posture, pointing fingers, invading personal space of antagonist, loud vocal projection
initial_state.apparent_goal: Defend the female employee and assert dominance over the manager
behavioral_evidence: Maintains intense eye contact with antagonist
Physically positions himself between the manager and the employee

final_state.body_language_summary: Open posture, smiling (Duchenne), leaning back in chair, offering hugs
final_state.apparent_goal: Provide restitution and improve the employee's life
behavioral_evidence: Relaxed seated posture in office chair
Yelling 'You can't treat people like this!'
Dismissing the manager with hand waves

characters.physical_description: Adult female, blonde hair, black work uniform (Scene 1), black cardigan (Scene 2)

initial_state.body_language_summary: Hand covering mouth/face, slumped shoulders, avoiding eye contact, leaning on counter
initial_state.apparent_goal: Avoid further conflict and escape the situation

final_state.body_language_summary: Smiling, making eye contact, relaxed shoulders, nodding

behavioral_evidence: Transition from defensive posture (hand on face) to open posture

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject observes violation of social contract (mistreatment of employee) -> Experiences anger -> Engages in confrontational behavior to re-establish norms and punish violator.

supporting_evidence.description: Aggressive pointing at the manager while verbalizing demands for apology.
Physically ejecting the manager from the space ('Get out').

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: He may be motivated primarily by asserting his own power rather than protecting the employee.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: His subsequent behavior (comforting the employee, offering money) suggests altruism/protection was the primary driver, not just ego.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject is in a high-conflict environment -> Displays physiological signs of distress (crying, hiding face) -> Verbalizes desire to leave employment ('I'm ready to quit').

supporting_evidence.description: States 'I'm ready to quit' while looking down, indicating a desire to flee the aversive stimulus.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Threat (manager) is removed -> Subject orients immediately to victim -> Offers resources (money, job security) -> Validates victim's emotions.

supporting_evidence.description: States 'I'm going to triple your salary'.
Physically handing cash/card to the employee at the ATM.

trigger_event.description: Employee states she is ready to quit.

behavioral_markers.description: Turns body completely away from the door (where manager left) to face the employee directly.
Voice drops from shouting volume to conversational/reassuring volume.

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment he stops pointing at the door, turns 90 degrees to the employee, and leans in on the counter.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The removal of the antagonist allows the protagonist to shift from a defensive/aggressive state (protecting the group norm) to a nurturing state (protecting the individual victim).

trigger_event.description: Protagonist offers a hug and reassurance.

behavioral_markers.description: Leans into the embrace rather than pulling away.
Crying shifts from distress (grimace) to relief (sobbing into shoulder).

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: When she accepts the hug, wrapping her arms around him and resting her head on his shoulder.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The validation from the authority figure resolves the immediate threat and uncertainty, allowing the subject to fulfill the need for belonging and comfort.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Repeated aggressive pointing, chopping hand motions
Hand on forehead, eyes closed, deep exhale
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Suggests a desire for Physiological_Rest_Seeking or Safety_Psychological_Protection.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Inserting cash/card into ATM slot and handing it to employee

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: Protagonist confronts manager while employee watches in distress.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: High-arousal conflict showing conflicting desires: Dominance/Justice (Protagonist) vs. Defense (Manager) vs. Avoidance (Employee).

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: Protagonist comforts the crying employee at the bar.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Clear transition from professional distance to social intimacy/care (Maslow level shift from Safety to Belonging).

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: Protagonist's display of power and benevolence directly reduces Employee's anxiety and shifts her desire from avoidance to affiliation.

key_interaction_moments.description: Protagonist turns to Employee to offer a raise immediately after firing the manager.
Physical embrace signaling safety and acceptance.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The video contains a third character (manager/antagonist) who acts as a catalyst for the desires of the two main subjects but is not fully annotated for desire dynamics due to his early exit from the scene.
